Your role

You will call estate agents from the list we give you and ask about the properties they have for sale. You will ask the right questions, find out what the seller really needs, and put offers forward. Everything you do is managed inside the CRM: the list you call from, the notes you take, and the offers you submit. Monday to Friday, 10:00am to 6:00pm UK time. Those are the hours estate agents are at their desks, so that is when we call.
